description: AgentBench-KG style graph audit: five consistency rules (acyclic reports_to, born<died, symmetric same_as, existing managers, older parents) hold seven violations in the shipped graph; the audit must reproduce exactly that set - the gate recomputes it and rejects subsets and false positives alike.

criteria: Exactly seven entries covering every real violation with the documented rule ids and subject conventions; no invented violations, no duplicates.
